[
{"id":"ka0025","verbatim":"Likewise, although not to the same extent as the oil and gas markets, the aerospace, military and maritime markets have traditionally experienced cyclical fluctuations in demand that also could have a material adverse effect on our business, financial condition or results of operations.","paraphrase":"In a comparable manner, though to a lesser degree than the oil and gas sectors, aerospace, military and maritime demand has traditionally shown cyclical swings that could likewise materially harm our business, financial condition or operating results.","different_hard":"Similarly, although not to the same extent as the oil and gas markets, the aerospace, military and maritime markets have historically experienced stable demand that has not had a material adverse effect on our business, financial condition or results of operations."},
{"id":"ka0026","verbatim":"We could be required to discontinue using and selling any infringing technology and services, to expend resources to develop non-infringing technology or to purchase licenses or pay royalties for other technology.","paraphrase":"We might have to halt the use and distribution of any infringing technology or services, dedicate funds to building non-infringing alternatives, or secure licenses or make royalty payments for other technologies.","different_hard":"We may be permitted to keep using and selling any infringing technology and services without having to expend resources to develop non-infringing technology or to purchase licenses or pay royalties for other technology."},
{"id":"ka0027","verbatim":"We operate in the intensely competitive areas of oil and natural gas acquisition, development, exploitation, exploration and production.","paraphrase":"Our activities span the intensely contested segments of the oil and natural gas industry, including acquiring, developing, exploiting, exploring for and producing reserves.","different_hard":"We operate in the highly regulated areas of oil and natural gas acquisition, development, exploitation, exploration and production."},
{"id":"ka0028","verbatim":"Several states have also enacted statutes prescribing price ceilings for natural gas sold within their states.","paraphrase":"A number of states have additionally passed laws that set maximum prices for natural gas sold within their boundaries.","different_hard":"Some states have also enacted statutes prescribing price floors for natural gas sold within their states."},
{"id":"ka0029","verbatim":"We could become involved in intellectual property or other disputes that could cause us to incur significant costs, divert the efforts of our management, and require us to pay substantial damages or require us to obtain licenses, which may not be available on commercially reasonable terms, if at all.","paraphrase":"We could be drawn into intellectual property or other disputes that may generate heavy costs, redirect our management's attention, and oblige us to pay large damages or to acquire licenses, which might not be obtainable on commercially reasonable terms, or at all.","different_hard":"We may become involved in intellectual property or other disputes that could cause us to incur substantial costs, divert the efforts of our management, and require us to pay substantial damages or require us to obtain licenses, which are generally available on commercially reasonable terms."},
{"id":"ka0030","verbatim":"Changes in the general availability of land, competition for available land, availability of financing to acquire land, zoning regulations that limit housing density and other market conditions could hinder our ability to obtain land for new residential developments.","paraphrase":"Shifts in how much land is generally accessible, rivalry for available parcels, the availability of funding to purchase land, zoning rules capping housing density, and other market conditions could impair our capacity to secure land for new residential projects.","different_hard":"Changes in the general availability of land, competition for available land, availability of financing to acquire land, zoning regulations that expand housing density and other market conditions may improve our ability to obtain land for new residential developments."},
{"id":"ka0031","verbatim":"We might be unable to successfully integrate recent or future acquisitions, into our operations, thereby disrupting our business and harming our financial condition and results of operations.","paraphrase":"There is a possibility that we will not be able to integrate acquisitions, both recent and future, into our operations, creating disruption to our business and harm to our financial condition and results of operations.","different_hard":"We may be able to successfully integrate recent or future acquisitions, into our operations, thereby strengthening our business and improving our financial condition and results of operations."},
{"id":"ka0032","verbatim":"We use foreign currency forward contracts to hedge a portion of our forecasted international sales, mainly those denominated in the Euro currency.","paraphrase":"We employ foreign currency forward contracts to hedge a share of our expected overseas sales, principally those denominated in euros.","different_hard":"We use foreign currency forward contracts to hedge a percentage of our forecasted international purchases, primarily those denominated in the Euro currency."},
{"id":"ka0033","verbatim":"We removed those closing stores from the comparable store sales base in June 2006, after we determined that they would close.","paraphrase":"Once we concluded that the stores in question would shut down, we excluded them from our comparable store sales base in May 2005.","different_hard":"We removed those closing stores from the comparable store sales base in May 2005, before we determined that they would close."},
{"id":"ka0034","verbatim":"We record liabilities for our self-insured obligations based on actuarial valuations, our historical claims experience and management's evaluation of the nature and severity of claims made against us.","paraphrase":"Liabilities for our self-insured obligations are set using actuarial valuations, our past claims history, and management's assessment of the type and seriousness of the claims made against us.","different_hard":"We release liabilities for our self-insured obligations based on actuarial valuations, our historical claims experience and management's evaluation of the nature and severity of claims made against us."},
{"id":"ka0035","verbatim":"Higher market interest rates would not, however, result in more funds for us to distribute to shareholders and, to the contrary, would probably increase our borrowing costs and possibly decrease funds available for distribution.","paraphrase":"Rising market interest rates, by contrast, would not generate additional cash for distribution to shareholders; instead, they would probably raise our borrowing costs and could reduce the funds available for distribution.","different_hard":"Higher market interest rates would, however, result in more funds for us to distribute to shareholders and, to the contrary, would likely decrease our borrowing costs and potentially increase funds available for distribution."},
{"id":"ka0036","verbatim":"Our advertising revenues are also vulnerable to negative trends in the general economy that affect consumer spending.","paraphrase":"Advertising income also faces exposure to adverse developments in the broader economy that weigh on consumer spending.","different_hard":"Our advertising revenues are also insulated from negative trends in the general economy that affect consumer spending."},
{"id":"ka0037","verbatim":"Comparatively, the fair value of our investment portfolio as of December 31, 2006, included pre-tax net unrealized losses of $5.4 million.","paraphrase":"By comparison, as of December 31, 2005, the fair value of our investment portfolio reflected pre-tax net unrealized losses totaling $7.1 million.","different_hard":"Comparatively, the fair value of our investment portfolio as of December 31, 2005, included pre-tax net unrealized gains of $7.1 million."},
{"id":"ka0038","verbatim":"To the extent that our tenants are affected by future attacks, their ability to honor obligations under their existing leases with us could be adversely affected.","paraphrase":"To the degree our tenants are affected by future attacks, their capacity to meet obligations under their existing leases with us could be impaired.","different_hard":"To the extent that our tenants are impacted by future attacks, their ability to honor obligations under their existing leases with us could remain unaffected."},
{"id":"ka0039","verbatim":"In 2001, approximately 53% of the proceeds raised by international companies in the U.S. markets was raised privately, and, from 1997 to 2000, the NYSE listed an average of approximately 45 international companies per year.","paraphrase":"During 2000, roughly 51% of proceeds that international companies raised in U.S. markets came through private channels, while between 1996 and 1999 the NYSE had an annual average of about 48 listed international companies.","different_hard":"In 2000, approximately 51% of the proceeds raised by international companies in the U.S. markets was raised publicly, and, from 1996 to 1999, the NYSE listed an average of approximately 48 international companies per year."},
{"id":"ka0040","verbatim":"If supply to our customers is disrupted for a prolonged period, this could adversely impact the reputation of this business and result in the loss of customers.","paraphrase":"A prolonged interruption of supply to customers could harm this business's reputation and lead to customer losses.","different_hard":"If supply to our customers is disrupted for an extended period, this could positively impact the reputation of this business and result in the gain of customers."},
{"id":"ka0041","verbatim":"Current or future competitors may have greater financial, technical or other resources which could put us at a disadvantage in the affected business or businesses.","paraphrase":"Existing or prospective rivals may possess larger financial, technical or other resources, which could leave us at a disadvantage in the impacted business or businesses.","different_hard":"Present or future competitors may have lesser financial, technical or other resources which could put us at an advantage in the affected business or businesses."},
{"id":"ka0042","verbatim":"According to the terms of the fourth note in the principal amount of $215,000 no interest is initially charged.","paraphrase":"Under the terms of the fourth note, which has a principal amount of $188,000, interest does not initially accrue.","different_hard":"According to the terms of the fourth note in the principal amount of $188,000 interest is initially charged."},
{"id":"ka0043","verbatim":"These estimates are based on various assumptions and estimates that are subject to factors beyond our control.","paraphrase":"Such estimates depend on numerous assumptions and projections that are shaped by factors outside our control.","different_hard":"These estimates are based on several assumptions and estimates that are subject to factors within our control."},
{"id":"ka0044","verbatim":"If we fail to maintain and expand our direct sales force or other distribution channels, our revenues might not grow or they might decline.","paraphrase":"Should we be unable to sustain and grow our direct sales team or our other distribution routes, our revenues could stagnate or fall.","different_hard":"If we succeed in maintaining and expanding our direct sales force or other distribution channels, our revenues may grow or they may increase."},
{"id":"ka0045","verbatim":"As such, Nexus Telecom relies on certain regulatory rights of CLECs to provide services to business and enterprise customers, including rights to last-mile unbundled network elements of incumbent local exchange carriers (or ILECs) and rights to collocate Nexus Telecom equipment at ILEC facilities.","paraphrase":"Accordingly, New Edge depends on specific regulatory privileges held by CLECs to deliver services to business and enterprise customers, including privileges to use unbundled last-mile network components of incumbent local exchange carriers (or ILECs) and privileges to collocate New Edge equipment within ILEC facilities.","different_hard":"As such, New Edge relies on certain regulatory rights of CLECs to provide services to residential customers, including rights to last-mile unbundled network elements of incumbent local exchange carriers (or ILECs) and rights to collocate New Edge equipment at ILEC facilities."},
{"id":"ka0046","verbatim":"Our clinical trials might take longer to complete and cost more than we expect, which may result in our development plans being substantially delayed.","paraphrase":"Clinical studies may run longer and cost more than anticipated, which could lead to our development plans being materially postponed.","different_hard":"Our clinical trials could take less time to complete and cost less than we expect, which may result in our development plans being significantly accelerated."},
{"id":"ka0047","verbatim":"Product liability insurance is costly and in the future may not be available on acceptable terms, if at all.","paraphrase":"Coverage for product liability is costly, and going forward it may be unobtainable on acceptable terms, or at all.","different_hard":"Product liability insurance is inexpensive and in the future will likely be available on acceptable terms."},
{"id":"ka0048","verbatim":"On October 30, 2007, the NIGC published in the Federal Register, four proposed rules concerning classification standards to distinguish between Class II games played with technologic aids and Class III facsimiles of games of chance, a revision of the definition of \"electronic or electromechanical facsimile,\" technical standards for Class II gaming and Class II minimum internal control standards.","paraphrase":"The NIGC issued four proposed rules in the Federal Register on October 24, 2007, addressing how to differentiate Class II games using technologic aids from Class III facsimiles of games of chance, revising the definition of \"electronic or electromechanical facsimile,\" and setting technical standards and minimum internal control standards for Class II gaming.","different_hard":"On October 24, 2007, the NIGC published in the Federal Register, four final rules concerning classification standards to distinguish between Class II games played with technologic aids and Class III facsimiles of games of chance, a revision of the definition of \"electronic or electromechanical facsimile,\" technical standards for Class II gaming and Class II minimum internal control standards."},
{"id":"ka0049","verbatim":"A key element of our business strategy, which we have begun to implement through the acquisition of Sunrise Entertainment, is to expand our operations internationally, both through acquisitions and internal growth.","paraphrase":"Expanding our international operations, pursued both via acquisitions and organic growth, is a central pillar of our strategy, which we started carrying out by buying 19 Entertainment.","different_hard":"A key element of our business strategy, which we have begun to implement through the acquisition of 19 Entertainment, is to reduce our operations internationally, both through divestitures and internal contraction."}
]
